part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Health
questions: Is it important to you to eat healthy food? [Why?/Why not?]
If you catch a cold, what do you do to help you feel better? [Why?]
Do you pay attention to public information about health? [Why?/Why not?]
What could you do to have a healthier lifestyle?

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when you had to wait a long time for someone or something to arrive.
points: who or what you were waiting for
how long you had to wait
why you had to wait a long time
part2.closing: and explain how you felt about waiting a long time.

topics.title: Arriving early
questions: In what kinds of situations should people always arrive early?
How important it is to arrive early in your country?
How can modern technology help people to arrive early?

topics.title: Being patient
questions: What kinds of jobs require the most patience?
Is it always better to be patient in work (or studies)?
Do you agree or disagree that the older people are, the more patient they are?
